name: @agcomm/ai-runtime
description: Canonical Node.js runtime and TUI for AgComm .ai packages

scripts.verify:gateway-service: npm run build && npm --prefix ../gateway run build && node scripts/verify-gateway-service.mjs
scripts.test:pty: npm run build && npm --prefix ../gateway run build && node scripts/run-pty-test.mjs
scripts.test:unit: node --experimental-strip-types --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/http-provider.test.mjs tests/line-renderer.test.mjs tests/local-host.test.mjs tests/runtime.test.mjs tests/session-picker.test.mjs tests/terminal-app.test.mjs tests/terminal-renderer.test.mjs
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm --prefix ../gateway run build && npm run test:unit && npm run test:cli
